facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau annual report 2021/2022 states the Bureau became a corporate body under the Mauritius Standards Bureau Act 1993, in effect from 16 July 1993, with the object of preparing, framing, amending and revising standards, and developing Mauritian Standards (MS).

The Bureau's own Quality Assurance Unit, as third-party certification body, ran the National Information Security Management System Certification Scheme (ISO/IEC 27001) under its National Management Systems Certification Scheme Regulations 2008, and in 2021/2022 maintained certification of eight organisations to ISO/IEC 27001; the report names none of the eight, and says the scheme is accredited by MAURITAS for information security management systems.
